purpose: Teach: 淡い/申す/かけがえ/えらく/おぼえ/おろか/無邪気/あきれ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の壁、淡いベージュにしましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's paint the shop walls a soft beige.
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, as if she's thought about this carefully. Warm and collaborative tone. Slight pause before 'beige' — she wants Aoi to imagine it with her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様に「いらっしゃいませ」と申す気持ちでお迎えしましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, when you greet customers, do it with the feeling of a true welcome.
lines.style: Soft directive, not bossy. Speaking from experience, almost tender. The instruction lands lightly — she's not correcting, she's inviting Aoi into something better.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お店を「かけがえのない場所」と仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer told me they think of this shop as an irreplaceable place.
lines.style: Warm pleasure in her voice. Slight lift on 'irreplaceable' — she's sharing something that moved her. Quiet pride that Aoi's work created this.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、新メニューを、えらく気に入って下さったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer really did love the new menu, didn't they?
lines.style: Bright acknowledgment. The question mark is genuine delight, not seeking confirmation. Light energy — she's celebrating something Aoi got right.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のお名前を、しっかりおぼえましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's make sure we remember our customers' names.
lines.style: Calm direction with care underneath. She knows this matters. Not pushy — a shared commitment spoken gently, as if they're building something together.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューに不評を予想したのは、おろかだったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, worrying the new menu wouldn't work out — that was me overthinking, wasn't it?
lines.style: Self-aware, a little rueful. Laughs at herself quietly. The wryness is turned inward, not at Aoi. Admits the mistake with the ease of someone secure enough to.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お子様の無邪気な質問に、ホッとするね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, there's something reassuring about a child asking innocent questions.
lines.style: Reflective, almost dreamy. Exhales a small breath of relief. She's noticing something true about the shop because of Aoi's presence. Gentle wonder.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、繁忙期の対応に、あきれた表情をされてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, did you see that look on the customer's face during the busy rush? They were taken aback.
lines.style: Wry observation, tinged with understanding. Not cruel — she's reading the moment and sharing it with Aoi. Slight grimace. Both of them know it was rough.
